verdict.rationale: Chargebee supports event-driven automation via webhooks (events trigger webhooks, e.g. subscription_cancelled) and has built-in automated rule-like features such as Smart Retry (dynamic retry logic based on decline type) and Dunning (scheduled reminders/retries), but there is no evidence of a general user-definable 'if event X then action Y' rules engine for arbitrary custom actions. missing for 10: a configurable rules/automation builder letting users define arbitrary trigger-action logic beyond fixed webhooks/dunning/retry, independent confirmation of custom rule authoring.
